dimensions.detail: The API token can affect all social accounts connected to the AdaptlyPost group, but the artifact discloses this and advises using a dedicated revocable token and connecting only needed accounts.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is documentation-only markdown with no executable install scripts; setup requires configuring a disclosed ADAPTLYPOST_API_KEY environment variable.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The main skill instructions prominently require explicit confirmation before each post, confirmation of content, accounts, timing, and visibility, small-batch consent for bulk work, and draft defaults when uncertain or unattended.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No background workers, privilege escalation, hidden persistence, or local indexing are present; the only persistent element is the user-provided service token and ordinary conversation reuse of timezone.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The ability to list accounts, upload media, and create, schedule, draft, or bulk schedule posts is directly aligned with the stated AdaptlyPost social media management purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: Write-capable posting and upload endpoints are expected for this skill; the main SKILL.md offsets the risk with explicit preview and confirmation requirements before posting, batch consent, draft defaults, and no silent retries.
[SQP-2] expected: The YouTube public privacy default is disclosed in the platform reference, and the main instructions require confirming visibility for every post; users should still set privacyStatus intentionally.
llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to manage real social accounts through AdaptlyPost. Use a dedicated revocable token, connect only the accounts the agent needs, review every content/account/timing/visibility summary before approval, and prefer drafts for sensitive or unattended workflows.
llm.summary: This skill is a clearly disclosed social-posting integration that uses a dedicated API key and includes strong confirmation rules for public posting and media uploads.
